growth_signal.value: Raised $400M twice within a few months, taking its valuation from $9B to $12B and its total funding past $1B, and it agreed to buy another security startup, Oasis Security, for $1B.

raised.value: $1B total, including a $400M round in 2026 at a $12B valuation

entry.idea: Companies store huge amounts of sensitive data across cloud, SaaS and AI systems and often do not know where it all is or who can reach it, so Cyera scans it all and uses AI to find, classify and protect that data automatically.
entry.lesson: When a new technology (AI) changes how a valuable resource (data) is used, the old tools for protecting that resource stop working, and there is room for a new company built for the new way it is used.
entry.name: Cyera

growth.basis: number: funding raised and valuation increase
growth.reason: Two funding rounds of $400M each within about three months, a jump from $9B to $12B valuation, and a $1B acquisition all point to very fast growth.

market.reason: Almost every large company in the world now needs to secure its data and, increasingly, its AI systems, which is a huge and growing global market.

tech.reason: It uses solid AI-based classification and scanning engineering, but data-security scanning is a space several well-funded competitors are also building in.

entry.twist: It does not just find and label sensitive data once; it also watches the AI agents and non-human identities that touch that data, so it protects data at rest, in motion and while AI systems are actively using it.
entry.who_pays: Large enterprises and their security teams (CISOs) pay to license the platform to find and lock down sensitive data across their cloud and SaaS systems.
entry.why_now: Companies are rushing to plug AI tools and agents into their data, which multiplies the ways sensitive information can leak or be misused, making automatic, AI-aware data security suddenly urgent.
